title: Power down NVIDIA discrete GPU using acpi_call
summary: Use the acpi_call kernel module to manually turn off the dedicated NVIDIA GPU to save battery power. This method works for GPUs not supported by bbswitch.

aliases.text: отключить nvidia gpu для экономии батареи

steps.explain: Run the example script to find the correct ACPI call to turn off the GPU. Look for a line ending in 'works!'.
steps.expect: Output showing various attempts, with one line ending in 'works!' indicating the GPU is off.

verify.expect: The NVIDIA GPU should no longer be listed, or power consumption should drop significantly.

rollback.explain: Reboot the system to restore the GPU.

warnings: This change is not persistent across reboots.
If you experience issues with suspend/hibernate, you may need to re-enable the GPU before suspending.
